QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates "definitive" from "NOT definitive" (unread corpus, conjunction, missing tables), but never describes a distinct grade for "definitive for a reason that is not absence" (e.g. the name exists elsewhere, so the empty result is definitive about the corpus searched). The three-way split the item requires is not laid out. Its "definitive" and "NOT DEFINITIVE" categories also don't map onto definitive-for-scope vs definitive-for-another-reason vs not-definitive.
